title: Software Developer Roadmap
summary: Build from programming and computer science fundamentals into software engineering, backend/frontend development, databases, APIs, cloud systems and production-grade application development.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If an honours/research pathway is available, use the additional depth for advanced algorithms, distributed systems, cloud computing, AI-enabled software or software systems research.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build programming, DSA, databases, software engineering, web development and Git skills with deployable projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in backend, full stack, frontend, cloud/platform, mobile or specialised application development.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward senior software engineering, system design, technical ownership and architecture responsibilities.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine software engineering with cloud-native systems, AI-assisted development, cybersecurity, distributed systems and platform engineering.
